failures.ambiguousScope: The catalog scope could not be determined uniquely. Specify a subject area or data layer and try again.

failures.unavailable: AI Q&A is unavailable. Please try again.
failures.aiUnavailableSearchAvailable: AI Q&A is unavailable; traditional search is still available.
